title: Python Developer for AI-Powered CRM Automation

facts: Post: build an AI assistant using Python and LLM APIs.
Post: duplicate detection, basic customer data validation, lead categorization, customer interaction summaries, updating CRM records.
Post: connect to existing CRM through REST APIs; FastAPI and PostgreSQL; deploy to AWS.
CRM vendor not named, so the custom workbench is used. Personalization omitted (reviews say Hakims, ambiguous).

scenes.title: Here's how the assistant handles one new lead.
scenes.caption: Your CRM sends the lead to a FastAPI service, PostgreSQL runs the checks, the LLM sorts it, and the update goes back over REST.
scenes.beat: Here's the whole path for one sample lead, {{lead.name}} from {{lead.company}}. Your CRM sends her to a small FastAPI service. PostgreSQL checks her details and looks for an existing contact. Then the LLM picks a category and writes a summary, and the result goes back into your CRM.
details: Runs as a FastAPI service with PostgreSQL, deployed on AWS

metrics.name: Duplicate contact rate
metrics.definition: Contacts later confirmed as duplicates divided by all new contacts created in the same period.
